description.value:
Trigger An effect would knock you prone or move you against your will.

Cost 1 Tally

Going down is a decision, and you have not made it.

You are not knocked prone, or you move up to 10 feet less than the effect would move you, your choice. If the effect would do both, one point of Tally answers only one of them. You may use this while unable to act, but not while unconscious.

cinderfall.incomplete: On being forced prone or forcibly moved, at Cost 1 Tally: negate being knocked prone, or reduce the forced movement by 10 feet; usable while unable to act, not while unconscious. The Tally cost is the trigger mechanism itself, and Deadhand's Tally is entirely homebrew with zero schema footprint anywhere in this corpus -- the underlying effect shape would otherwise partially match real Immovable Object precedent (pf2e-source/packs/pf2e/feats/archetype/eternal-legend/immovable-object.json, rules: []).
